# FAN/IP

> FAN/IP gets brands talked about without an ad budget. It gives a brand its own fan club, under the brand's name: fans post about the brand on their own accounts, earn points, move up levels and unlock rewards, and the brand sees how many people those posts reached and what the same views would have cost as ads. Tagline: "Turn fandom into impact."

FAN/IP is for consumer brands, sports clubs, gaming venues and esports teams, and artists, labels and festivals. It works in three steps: the brand creates missions; fans take part and earn points; the brand's team approves posts, hands out rewards and follows the results. Each brand has its own name, colours, words, missions and rewards; FAN/IP runs behind it. FAN/IP is run by Alexis Collin in Cologne, Germany. Contact: contact@fan-ip.com.

- [Platform](https://fan-ip.com/platform.html): all fifty features in plain words (missions, predictions, check-ins, seasons, sprints, streaks, team battles, collection, rewards, creator tools, white-label, back office), with a playable member season
- [Approach](https://fan-ip.com/approach.html): the ten principles behind the product
- [Compare](https://fan-ip.com/compare.html): FAN/IP next to shop loyalty apps, community platforms, fan-token apps, group chats and building it yourself
- [Reach calculator](https://fan-ip.com/reach-calculator.html): estimate the views members' posts bring each month and their media value (views ÷ 1,000 × CPM, €2 by default, the same sum as in the FAN/IP admin)
- [FAQ](https://fan-ip.com/faq.html): plain answers about the platform, who it is for, how it works and what it costs
- [Book a demo](https://fan-ip.com/book-a-demo.html): one-hour video demo on demo data

## By type of client

- [Consumer brands](https://fan-ip.com/brands.html): beauty, fashion, food and lifestyle brands
- [Sports clubs](https://fan-ip.com/sports-clubs.html): supporters take part between two matches
- [Gaming and esports](https://fan-ip.com/gaming-esports.html): gaming venues, esports teams and game communities
- [Music](https://fan-ip.com/music.html): artists, labels and festivals

## Pricing (euros, excluding VAT)

- Starter: €99 a month or €990 a year, no setup fee, up to 150 active members a month, 7-day free trial, sign up online at https://app.fan-ip.com/start
- Club: €490 a month, setup €1,250, up to 1,500 active members a month
- Season: €1,290 a month, setup €2,500, up to 15,000 active members a month
- Signature: from €2,900 a month, setup from €5,000, more than 15,000 active members a month
- Club, Season and Signature are billed monthly on a 12-month term. An active member is someone who did something in the community this month.
